g.text: Grant lifecycle — Active, Revoked, and the UTC-epoch-day counter roll
same day, c < cap -> admit, c := c + 1
same day, c >= cap -> abort "grant daily run cap exhausted"
new day, cap > 0 -> admit, d := d(t), c := 1
over the deploy's own node-validated timestamp
the cap can land across one midnight
fresh window). The cap is an abuse throttle,
Revocation is DELIVERY-ONLY for in-flight runs:
the run completes for its owner; the grantee's
reveal and command claims fail from the moment
of revocation; the owner keeps cancel through
the ordinary command envelope. The record is
never deleted -- a public audit fact, flagged
Idempotent resend never double-counts: a re-registered
run_id verifies its identity and acknowledges without
grantor derived from the deploy's signer;
any field differing aborts "grant identity conflict"
